test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Choose the word that means the same as the given word.**

Villainous
solution:
The correct answer is **"Nefarious."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Villainous" means **relating to, constituting, or guilty of wicked or criminal behaviour. (दुष्ट या आपराधिक व्यवहार से संबंधित, गठित करने वाला या दोषी)

 
 
• **Example**: *This is a **villainous**__ plot.*
 
 
 
• **"Nefarious"** means extremely wicked or villainous. (पापी, दुष्ट, अपराधी, अधर्मी, जघन्य)
 __
 
• **Example: ***The **nefarious**__ plot of the evil mastermind was finally uncovered by the detectives. *
 
 
 
• It is an adjective that describes someone or something that is morally evil or criminal in nature.
 
• So, the word that means the same as the given word is **"Nefarious."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 (**Wholesome**) means promoting health or well-being; it is the opposite of villainous. (शारीरिक स्‍वास्‍थ्‍य के लिए हितकर, स्‍वास्‍थ्‍यवर्धक, पुष्टिकर, पौष्टिक)
 
• Option 2 (**Lucid**) means clear and easy to understand; it is not a synonym for villainous. ((भाषण या लेखन) समझने में स्‍पष्‍ट और सरल, सुबोध)
 
• Option 4 (**Famous**) means well-known or celebrated; it is not a synonym of villainous. (प्रख्‍यात; जिन्‍हें लोग अच्‍छे कार्यों के लिए जानें)
